headline: Two NHL players placed on waivers for Nov. 7
take:
Daily Faceoff reports two players went on waivers Saturday: Atro Leppanen and Rangers goalie James Reimer.

Reimer is the name most fans will know, and the move turned out to be a step toward the exit: The Hockey News later reported that the Rangers and Reimer had mutually agreed to terminate his contract. His only appearance this season came in relief, three goals on eight shots, and he finished last season 1.67 goals below expected over 14 games. At this stage of a long career, a waiver placement is rarely about another team claiming him and more often about clearing a path.

Leppanen hasn't played enough NHL hockey this season for our numbers to say anything useful about him.
